Name: Yes We're Dating--Haley(Chinese Translation)
Author: Ahacker
Description:
[size=3]Are you tired of your girlfriend/boyfriend's dialogue after you start dating defaulting to the normal dialogue, or the dating dialogue you do see not really being up to par?你是否厌倦了恋爱开始后，你的女朋友/男朋友的对话总是千篇一律，或者你看到的恋爱对话质量不高？
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]Well, this mod aims to help with that!
这个模组就是为了解决这个问题而开发的！
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]With this mod, during seasons [/size][size=3]Winter through Summer[/size][size=3], you will see dating dialogue from [/size][size=3]Haley[/size][size=3]. I've determined you'd probably hit 8 hearts around Winter, which is why I've started dialogue during Winter! (if requested, I might add dialogue for Fall too for a year long dating experience--let me know!)
有了这个 mod，从冬季到夏季，你就能看到海莉的约会对话。我估计你大概会在冬季达到 8 颗心的好感度，所以我就把对话设定在了冬季！（如果有人需要，我可能会添加秋季的对话，这样就能体验一整年的约会了——请告诉我！）
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]By default, Haley will [/size][size=3]occasionally[/size][size=3] acknowledge if your [/size][size=3]player's gender is the same as hers[/size][size=3], therefore if you play as a female farmer, she will mention it in her dialogue. If you'd prefer to have her [/size][size=3]not mention[/size][size=3] your farmer's gender, you can turn this off via Generic Mod Config Menu.
默认情况下，如果玩家角色的性别与海莉相同，海莉会偶尔提及。因此，如果您扮演的是一位女性农民，她会在对话中提到这一点。如果您不希望她提及您扮演的农民的性别，可以通过通用模组配置菜单将其关闭。
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]You will see 65+ new lines of dialogue, including:
您将看到 65 条以上的新对话，其中包括：
[/size][size=3]-3 [u]random[/u] variations of 8 heart dialogue for each day of the week in [/size][size=3]Winter
冬季期间，一周七天，每天随机出现 3 种不同的 8 心对话。
[/size][size=3]-3 [u]random[/u] variations of 10 heart dialogue for each day of the week in [/size][size=3]Spring
-春季一周七天，每天随机出现3种不同的10级心形对话。
[/size][size=3]-3 [u]random[/u] variations of 10 heart dialogue for each day of the week in [/size][size=3]Summer[/size]
[size=3]夏季[/size][size=3]期间，一周七天，每天都会有 3 种[u]随机[/u]的 10 点好感度对话变体。[/size][size=3]
3 [u]random[/u] variations of Rainy dialogue
Rainy 对话的 3 个[u]随机[/u]变体
[/size][size=3]-and some [/size][size=3]proposal[/size][size=3] dialogue!
还有一些提案对话！

[/size][size=2](She will start getting impatient on Sundays in Summer if you haven't proposed to her, but i find it to be part of her charm lol)
（如果你夏天星期天还没向她求婚，她就会开始不耐烦，但我认为这是她魅力的一部分，哈哈）
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]I have plans to release a mod for each Bachelor/ette, and possibly release one big multipack mod when/if they all get done. Please enjoy, and let me know if there's anything that needs fixing or any suggestions you may have. Thank you!
我计划为每位单身可恋爱NPC都发布一个 MOD，如果全部完成，可能会发布一个大型的合集 MOD。请尽情体验，如果发现任何需要修复的问题或有任何建议，请告诉我。谢谢！
[/size]以上为原MOD的简介内容
[b][size=5]Mod by: @kettuluv 
原作者：@kettuluv
Thank you @kettuluv for bringing us such a great mod![/size][/b]
